escena_base: the Barkademy classroom (chalkboard that reads 'Barkademy', dog cubbies, paw prints on the wall)
premisa: Pepe (profe/cuidador) trata de enseñarles a dar la pata. Corre el gag 'Give me the paw!' y cada perro lo subvierte a su manera. Comedia + ternura. Termina en montaña de perros.

panels.accion: Rex limps over to Pepe with one paw raised as if it hurts, milking the drama like a wounded soldier

dialogo.dice: I am always in interior pain.

panels.comedia: Setup del gag + primer subversión: drama exagerado.

panels.accion: SirWheeze stays lying flat on the floor and just slides his paw across the ground toward Pepe without lifting it at all

dialogo.dice: Close enough, yes? Okay, yes... resting time. That was exhausting.

panels.accion: Tank trembles with fury, growling, refusing to cooperate, tiny but convinced he's terrifying

dialogo.dice: No growling, Tank. Just give me the paw.
Come and get it, you coward.

panels.comedia: Rebeldía del chiquito con ego gigante. Planta el callback del final.

panels.accion: Bear gives the paw perfectly, calm and proud, like a wise mentor grading his student

dialogo.dice: Perfect instruction, kid. Keep at it.

panels.comedia: Vuelta de tuerca: Bear es quien 'enseña' a Pepe y está orgulloso de él.

panels.accion: Bruno stares playfully at Pepe's empty open hand, confused but happy; then bursts forward and licks Pepe all over his face while Pepe laughs

dialogo.dice: There's no ball in your hand.
Come on, Bruno, give me the paw!
No cookie in your hand... no ball, no cookie... what are we playing, master? Oh! I know!

panels.comedia: Lógica de bobo feliz. Remata con lamida y risa (ternura).

panels.accion: Kaiser snaps his paw up perfectly with a dead-serious military face, then side-eyes the other dogs
panels.comedia: El milico perfeccionista que desprecia al resto.

panels.accion: Africa says she knows what he REALLY wants and tackles Pepe, knocking him over VERY playfully; all the dogs pile on to play — a happy mountain of dogs — Pepe laughing hard underneath

dialogo.dice: The paw? I know what you want!
Yeah — I got you AND your paw. I warned you.

panels.comedia: Clímax de ternura (montaña de perros) + callback de Tank que cierra el chiste.

caption: Day one at Barkademy: teaching the paw. Results... varied. 🐾
